_about: Real raw ConPTY output (Windows 11, PS 5.1 host, 80x24) of Claude Code 2.1.303 (its default view, and claude-full: its fullscreen tui setting), Codex 0.153.4 and Antigravity CLI 1.4.2 (GitHub #36, the submit review of fix/swarm154). held is the input box holding a prompt left there unsent; cleared is the same box once twenty Ctrl+U in one write cleared it (each agent shows its empty box, or the hint it shows there); cleared-tall is a task of 30 lines typed into the cleared box, taller than the box, so only its end shows. claude-80x24-paste-* is Claude Code holding its own placeholder for a paste of the text about to be typed: two writes of twenty Ctrl+U cleared it, the first showing nothing for two seconds (paste-cleared-once), and the text typed again shows as a placeholder of its own; claude-80x24-pasteother-* holds the placeholder of another paste, cleared by one write, then a task of 26 lines typed. raw is what readOutput(terminalId, 1000) returned then, cut to the shortest end of it that draws the same screen; text is what was typed into the box. Personal strings are replaced by ones of equal length.
